description: Combine the fully integrated fast-n=32/n=352/clustered-n=512 solver with the selected n=1024 clustered path: reconcile SM100 launch attributes, packed reflectors, high-precision cleanup and certificates, preserve all existing stress suites plus n=1024 structure routing, remove duplicate generic kernels, and profile all five custom sizes.

Integrated the selected n1024 solver into the fully combined n32/n176/n352/n512 parent by reusing its generic packed cluster-prefix reducer, serial tail, and monolithic tridiagonal kernel rather than adding duplicate kernels. Added the 4x768-thread 768-column n1024 launch, guarded 26-eigenpair solve, 1024-thread unpack, high-precision WY and two-high/one-strict cleanup, exact certificate, structure gate, and Xsyev fallback. Build, kernelguard, and all 39 tests pass. Full geomean improves from 37581.232 to 37057.961 us; n1024 standard/mixed/nearrank/geometric are 87136.617/106232.277/105798.688/102777.832 us, while n32/n176/n352 are 68.736/993.640/6531.642 us.

Unified packed-reflector unpack at 1024 threads for both n512 and n1024 so the shared generic kernel uses the selected full-occupancy launch at both sizes. Build, kernelguard, and all 39 tests pass. Full geomean is 37056.869 us versus 37057.961 for the 256-thread n512 unpack; n512 standard/mixed are 118059.008/150509.099 us versus 118215.724/150725.922 in the prior sample, while other unchanged terms and n2048 variance make this a noise-level aggregate change.

Final HEAD a60766fec360aa19b988df6ecbfd36c21501cda6 combines the integrated n32/n176/n352/clustered-n512 solver with the selected n1024 path without duplicating the generic packed prefix, serial tail, tridiagonal, or unpack kernels. It adds the guarded 26-eigenpair n1024 solve, 4x768-thread/768-column cluster launch, high-precision WY backtransform, two tensor-core plus one strict cleanup passes, exact certificate, structure gate, and Xsyev fallback. Trial 0 measured 37057.961 us versus parent 37581.232; trial 1 unified the n512/n1024 unpack at 1024 threads and measured 37056.869 us, with a clean-tree remeasure at 37085.793 us. Build, kernelguard, and all 39 official stress tests pass. Final-SHA nsys profiles cover all five custom sizes: n32 fused/classifier 59.700/4.010 us; n176 reducer/solve 467.881/394.062 us; n352 reducer/panel-QR/backtransform 3.623/1.249/0.815 ms; n512 prefix/tail/solve/unpack 2.936/52.210/18.922/0.233 ms; n1024 prefix/tail/solve/unpack/certificate 57.031/1.869/11.303/0.247/0.277 ms. The unified launch reduced n512 unpack from about 0.290 to 0.233 ms. Keep the tree moving: concrete openings are replacing the inherited n512 52 ms serial tail with a blocked reducer, panelizing the n1024 57 ms Householder prefix with tensor-core compact-WY updates or fewer DSM barriers, removing n352's 1.249 ms panel-QR staging, fusing strict cleanup with the exact certificate, and calibrating per-matrix n1024 structure routing to avoid whole-batch fallback without losing the stress passes.
